Thanks again for taking time earlier — great convo and excited about the use case you described for Acme's recommendations engine. As discussed, next step on our side is to kick off the vendor security questionnaire so your security team can evaluate Redwood.

I've attached a short SIG/CAIQ initiation form that helps us understand the scope (hosted vs private, environments, expected data types) and will let us route the right controls and artifacts. Can you please: 
- Confirm whether you're looking to evaluate our Hosted API (multi-tenant) or Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment?
- Confirm primary security contact for the questionnaire (name + email + preferred times for a 30-min sync).

- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report; I'll share the redacted report once NDA is in place.
- Data residency/GDPR: we support region routing and data controls; specific residency options are available on Dedicated/Private.
- Encryption: we support encryption in transit and at rest; for Private and Dedicated customers we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).

Attached: Redwood_SIG_Initiation_Form.pdf (please fill the short form) and Redwood_Security_Pack.zip (overview docs and redacted SOC 2).

Proposed next steps:
1) You fill and return the initiation form (or tell us you prefer we pull the SIG via SecureFile).
2) We'll route to our security team and aim to return a completed SIG (first pass) within 5-7 business days depending on scope.
3) If your security team prefers a live review, we can schedule a 30-min session for next week — I cc'd Dev to coordinate technical details.

Adding a few technical clarifying questions we should capture up front to avoid back-and-forth with your security team:
